objective: calibrated monocular offline person-object-scene reconstruction; CVPR2027
allowed_inputs: known object scan geometry without texture
historical_D: different input protocol; never attribute known-template advantage to proposed anchors

representation.human: SMPLX LBS+bounded canonical and regional time-varying residual; optimizable pose/shape
representation.object: one SE3 per timestamp, fixed canonical scan sampling; no time-varying per-Gaussian residual
representation.composition: single D native_add3 calibrated depth-sorted alpha renderer
representation.world_units: metres; world_scale=1; never apply c2w twice

stages.name: A_branch_warmup
stages.train: one selected branch at a time; visible RGB/mask; other foreground excludes hidden silhouette supervision

stages.name: B_joint_pose
stages.train: human pose + object SE3 + bounded regional human residual; freeze Gaussian appearance/geometry

stages.name: C_joint_refine
stages.train: all branches jointly RGB, instance, pose, motion, residual and ordinary track

track_source: identical frozen CoTracker pool; same source-target schedule and budgets
S0_S1_fairness: share exact initial state and deterministic source/pair schedule; may share common prefix checkpoint including optimizer/RNG; only track end differs
S2_S3: Not entered: reliable small-projection-error whole-entity support loss not repeated in two S1 events. Investigate absolute object initialization and rotation-identity branch first.
resource_policy: root allocates GPUs; GPU1 sm86 rendering; GPU0 allowed frozen pure-torch preprocessing; cts excluded from HOI; no5090GPU
evaluation: frozen checkpoint only, no fitted alignment; keep all preset samples and failures; independent references separate from training
ordinary_track_loss: MoSca-style composited target-camera XYZ projected to target RGB, SmoothL1 norm beta5px; no freely moving anchor. Source/target CoTracker valid & same RGB entity interior, maximum512.
sampling: precomputed8000 source/target pairs; identical S0/S1, including cutoff; same-point records not added
density_note: seen_count means radii>0 projected candidate, NOT true visibility. Pruning needs low opacity and count>=3; unknown-hidden is not directly penalized. Same ordinary policy forS0/S1.
implementation_status: Both controlled pairs trained8000steps and completed frozen export, fitted geometry, fixed queries where available, heldout regions and support diagnostics. Subsequent simple pose-only pilot separate; training frozen.
